problem_statement: The UUID library needs a way to determine whether a given UUID is the Nil/empty UUID — the special form defined in RFC9562 where all 128 bits are zero. The check must return true when given an all-zero UUID and when given a UUID parsed from the canonical string "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", and must return false for a UUID that has any non-zero byte (for example the UUID parsed from "44b35f73-cfbd-43b4-8fef-ca7baea1375f").
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/lib/uuid -s tests/lib/uuid/libraries.uuid.base -s libraries.uuid.base -O twister-out --no-clean -W

verification.reason: The task is fair if the statement specifies the exact public API the hidden test uses, namely bool uuid_is_nil(const struct uuid *data), and the required true/false behavior for the Nil UUID.

problems.detail: The hidden test calls uuid_is_nil, but the problem statement only says 'a way to determine' and does not give the required public function name, parameter type, or return type.

problem_statement_fixed: The UUID library needs a way to determine whether a given UUID is the Nil/empty UUID — the special form defined in RFC9562 where all 128 bits are zero. The check must be provided by a public function bool uuid_is_nil(const struct uuid *data). It must return true when given an all-zero UUID and when given a UUID parsed from the canonical string "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", and must return false for a UUID that has any non-zero byte (for example the UUID parsed from "44b35f73-cfbd-43b4-8fef-ca7baea1375f").
